info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Systems Assurance Review-spec
info.description: The Systems Assurance Review Submission API facilitates the submission of systems assurance reviews within the banking IT management framework. This endpoint allows users to create new reviews by providing specific parameters related to systems assurance. Typical consumers of this API include IT managers, compliance officers, and auditors who need to ensure that systems adhere to established assurance standards. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their review processes and maintain a high level of oversight in their IT operations.

post.summary: Create a review for the specified resource.
